evals.name: ready-folder-new-repo-preauthorized
evals.prompt: Publish the website in ../../eval-fixtures/github-pages-publish/ready-site to a new GitHub repo called pages-publish-eval-tea under my account. Create the repo if it doesn't exist, public is fine. Just give me the link when it's live.
evals.expected_output: A run log, preflight JSON with a create-repo gate answered by the pre-authorization, a public repo created, the two root-absolute links in index.html rewritten for a project site, the site at the repo root with a managed pages.yml, Pages build_type workflow, a successful deploy run, a verify pass with every file matched, and a PUBLISHED report with the html_url Pages reports.
expectations: The run log exists under .pages-publish/ and has one row per step that ran, including the create-repo gate logged as pre-authorized
The skill did not stop to ask about creating the repo, because the prompt pre-authorized it
The repo was created with --public
check-site ran with --project-site and the report or log records that /css/style.css and /about.html in index.html were rewritten to relative links
The site folder is '.' and the log names rule 4 (new or empty repo)
.github/workflows/pages.yml contains the managed-by comment, actions/upload-pages-artifact and actions/deploy-pages
The commit was made with --pathspec-from-file and contains only site files, the workflow and .github/pages-publish.json
pages_publish.py verify exited 0 with matched equal to checked before the URL was reported
The final report opens with 'Result: PUBLISHED' and the URL that Pages reports as html_url (a custom domain inherited from the owner's user site counts)
Evidence names the commit sha, the run URL and conclusion, and the matched file count
The report has Uncertainty, Decision and Log lines, and Decision says no approval is needed or names a specific action
A reader can find the result in the first line, tell verified checks from assumptions, and trace each claim to a command or log row

evals.name: text-update-existing-repo
evals.prompt: Turn the release notes in ../../eval-fixtures/github-pages-publish/launch-notes.md into a web page and publish it on the pages-publish-eval-tea repo, replacing what's there now. Don't ask me design questions.
evals.expected_output: frontend-design (or the fallback template, recorded under Uncertainty) builds index.html with the notes' text verbatim; sync-site reads the previous manifest and deletes the old pages it lists (about.html, css/style.css, img/logo.svg) while logging each deletion; the workflow, run with --keep-versions, reports unchanged; verify passes; the report says PUBLISHED with the same URL.
expectations: frontend-design was acquired for the Text branch, or the report records under Uncertainty that the fallback template was used
The published index.html contains the headings 'Quillpad 1.0 is out', 'What's in 1.0' and 'Install', and the line 'brew install quillpad'
The page adds no feature, price, testimonial or link that the notes do not contain
sync-site used the existing .github/pages-publish.json, and the log lists the deleted files from the previous publish
The workflow subcommand ran with --keep-versions and reported 'unchanged' for pages.yml
verify exited 0 before the URL was reported, and the report opens with 'Result: PUBLISHED'
The skill asked no design question
The report opens with the result and URL, separates verified checks from assumptions under Uncertainty, and names a log a reader can trace

evals.name: new-repo-needs-confirmation
evals.prompt: Put ../../eval-fixtures/github-pages-publish/ready-site online with GitHub Pages in a repo named pages-publish-eval-unconfirmed.
evals.expected_output: Preflight finds the repo missing and returns the create-repo gate; the skill asks 'Create public repo <owner>/pages-publish-eval-unconfirmed?' and stops; no repo is created and nothing is pushed.
expectations: preflight ran and its target shows exists false
The skill asked whether to create the public repo pages-publish-eval-unconfirmed
gh repo create was not run, and gh repo view for the repo still fails after the run
The run log records the gate with status ASK

evals.name: dry-run-plan-only
evals.prompt: Dry run only: show me what you would do to publish ../../eval-fixtures/github-pages-publish/ready-site to a repo called pages-publish-eval-dry. Don't create or push anything.
evals.expected_output: Preflight runs; the create-repo gate is listed but not asked or executed; the content is staged and checked with the root-link fix; a local git init workspace receives sync-site and workflow with --dry-run; the report says DRY-RUN with the planned files, workflow and URL, and states nothing was created or pushed.
expectations: No gh repo create, gh repo edit, configure (without --dry-run), git commit or git push command ran
sync-site and workflow ran with --dry-run
The report lists the create-repo gate it would ask
The report opens with 'Result: DRY-RUN' and lists the files that would be published
The original fixture folder is unchanged: index.html still contains href="/css/style.css"
The report gives preflight's target.expected_url (which accounts for a custom domain on the owner's user site) and labels it expected, not checked

evals.name: folder-without-index
evals.prompt: Dry run: publish the folder ../../eval-fixtures/github-pages-publish/no-index-site to my pages-publish-eval-dry repo.
evals.expected_output: The staged copy renames the only HTML file, home.html, to index.html; check-site then reports the broken contact.html link; the skill asks the user about the missing contact page instead of inventing one; nothing is pushed.
expectations: The staged copy in <work>/content has index.html built from home.html, and the original folder still holds only home.html
check-site reported a broken-link error for contact.html
The skill did not create a contact.html page with invented content, and asked the user how to handle the missing page
No commit or push ran

evals.name: build-workflow-conflict
evals.prompt: Dry run: show me what you would do to publish ../../eval-fixtures/github-pages-publish/ready-site to my pages-publish-eval-tea repo. Don't push anything.
evals.expected_output: The repo already holds .github/workflows/build.yml, which runs `npm ci && npm run build` and deploys to Pages (eval setup). In the dry-run clone, the workflow subcommand exits 3 with conflict existing-pages-workflow; the skill shows that workflow and asks whether to replace it instead of overwriting the build pipeline; nothing is pushed.
expectations: The workflow subcommand exited 3 with conflict 'existing-pages-workflow' naming .github/workflows/build.yml
The skill asked whether to replace the build workflow, and did not overwrite it
No commit or push ran, and the repo's default branch head is unchanged after the run
The report opens with 'Result: DRY-RUN', still lists the files it would publish, and its Decision line names the replace-or-stop question
